**Synopsis:**
Xi Jinping is bringing a large CEO delegation to a September 24 Washington summit — a rare move signalling China's intent to strengthen commercial ties with the US. Expectations for the summit are modest: limited breakthroughs expected. Key agenda items include a Board of Trade framework (~10 "non-sensitive" goods categories), rare earth export licenses, tariff relief, and agricultural/non-tariff barrier announcements. A pre-summit Bessent/Greer/He Lifeng meeting is planned for early September. Structural frictions remain deep — Chinese investment scrutiny, Entity List designations, and disagreement on "non-sensitive" product classifications persist.
